evidence.mission_note: As a body-on-frame, KDSS-equipped 4WD SUV, this GX460 offers genuine off-road/tow capability the household RX350 does not have, fitting the utility_capability mission well — but with urgency in accelerated_bridge mode rather than emergency mode, Jason can and should insist on a full PPI before treating this as more than a promising, unverified candidate.
evidence.rationale: This listing is a plausible capability-differentiated candidate — priced competitively against comps and offering real off-road/tow capability the RX350 lacks — but it is thin on documentation and silent on every model-critical risk point (KDSS, secondary air injection, rust, and the actual service history behind the vague 'just had a service done' claim). At 118k miles, the GX460's known weak points (valley-plate/timing-cover seepage, KDSS leaks, secondary air pump failures) are squarely in play, and none are addressed by receipts, scan data, or photos. The clean title and low-owner-count claims are seller assertions only, not verified via any history report. Cosmetic condition looks good in the photos provided, and the price sits reasonably within the comp set and Jason's budget. Given the mission fit is strong but the documentation is weak, this car is worth pursuing only if a specialist PPI clears the major mechanical unknowns.
evidence.next_action: Request full service records and the VIN for a history report, then schedule a specialist PPI covering KDSS leak-down, secondary air injection codes, and underbody rust before making any offer.
